clause: c2 'Then create 12 Gems of one of their Mana Colors.' / native step 2 CreateGems Color1=FromTarget Amount 12
expected: One mana colour of the chosen ally is picked once per cast; all 12 created gems are that single colour
actual: gems.ts pickCreateGemType calls resolveColor('LAST_TARGET') per gem, and resolveColor rolls char.colors[rng] each call, so a Red+Purple ally yields a Red/Purple mix (seed 42: 2 colours). The conversion pool is also filtered only by the first probe colour. Same pattern likely affects CHOSEN_TARGET / ENEMY / TRACKED_ENEMY colour specs on create (e.g. troop:7162 only verified with a single-colour ally).
repro: tests/unit/gowLaneL4bB01.test.ts > L4b troop:7138/spell:8687 ... > two-colour ally seed=42: all 12 gems share ONE colour (it.fails)

clause: c2 'Then create a mix of 22 Skulls and Yellow Gems.' / native step 2 CreateGems2Colors Skull+Yellow Amount 22
expected: 22 board cells become Skull or Yellow; no selected cell is already of the type it is 'created' as
actual: gems.ts doCreate builds the full-board convertible pool excluding only the first probe type (probe drawn from mixAny). When probe=SKULL, Yellow cells stay eligible and a later per-gem pick of Yellow leaves them unchanged (seed 7: e.g. (4,1) Yellow->Yellow), so fewer than 22 gems are effectively created. Affects every mix/mixAny create on a board containing an endpoint colour.
repro: tests/unit/gowLaneL4bB01.test.ts > L4b troop:7200/spell:8787 ... > seed=7 Yellow-bearing board: none of the 22 changes is a same-type no-op (it.fails; documents current behaviour, the test-file comment predates the reclassification)

sourceDispute.level: community discussion (no developer answer in thread)
sourceDispute.finding: Players report that 2-colour creators (e.g. Lava Troll Red/Brown) can overwrite existing gems of those colours, and that of N created cells a new gem may land where the same colour already was. This supports the current runtime (same-colour overwrite allowed) rather than my expectation. Not ingested into gold-primary-sources, so it cannot be cited for signoff yet.
sourceDispute.recommendation: fix window: ingest the page or find an official statement; if accepted, close as no-difference and re-review troop:7200 (still blocked by L4b-7200-rage-alias) and troop:6340.

fixNote: rulings/RL4b-01-two-colour-overwrite.md (ingested gold-primary-sources/community-2019-08-12-two-colour-create-overwrite.json): same-colour overwrite allowed; B01 test flipped to assert 22 distinct cells / endpoint types

actual: Prototype runs damage(enemyAll) before status poison(enemyAll): skill-damage events precede status-apply.
